ID modułu to etykieta urządzenia. Dla ka: Configure each signal manually: module ID is a label, not a frame selector. Enter frame ID (decimal or 0xHEX), zero-based byte offset, numeric type and LE/BE order. Data, status and age have independent optional Holding Register addresses (100–65535, zero-based, unique). Blank fields disable that mapping. Multiplier 1–1000 produces an int16 result. Save to apply. Invalid or stale values are published as zero. Statuses: 0 waiting; 1 OK; 2 sensor fault; 3 stale data; 4 invalid format; 5 unconfigured; 6 int16 overflow; 7 diagnostics unconfigured; 8 CAN error; 9 heartbeat error; 10 matching error frame missing; 12 disabled (raw, data and age zero, no signal alarm). State 11 NO HUB is reserved for local HMI logic. The switch does not power off the sensor. Error and measurement frames must have version 1 and matching sample counters in byte 1. Age 65535 means no sample. See the manual for details.
